changes.text: 原文又记李左车说：「智者千慮，必有一失；愚者千慮，必有一得」，所以有句话说，狂夫之言，圣人也从中择取。一种解读是：一位刚刚亡国、被生擒的人，在这里讲的，近乎是任何人都可能出错——而他同时也说了，愚者也会有所得。

The text also records Li Zuoche saying that the wise man, in a thousand considerations, must have one failure, and the fool, in a thousand considerations, must have one success — hence the saying, the sage still picks through a madman's words. One reading is that a man whose state had just fallen, taken alive, here suggests that anyone can be wrong — while also allowing that even a fool can be right.
还有两处必须留白。第一，「誠令成安君聽足下計，若信者亦已爲禽矣」是韩信本人事后的说法，无法检验，本文只把它当作韩信的自我解释来记，不当作事实。第二，陈馀的想法，本文严格按原文所记的理由写，不替他补充任何心理活动；至于他若采纳那条计会怎样，是作者提出的分析情形，不是记录，也永远不会有答案。

Two things must stay open. First, Han Xin's statement that, had the Lord of Cheng'an heeded Li Zuoche's plan, a man like him would already have been taken is his own claim after the event, untestable; this piece records it as his explanation of himself, not as fact. Second, where Chen Yu's mind is concerned, this piece follows exactly the reasons the text gives and adds nothing; what would have happened had he adopted the plan is an analytical counterfactual the author offers, not a record, and it will never have an answer.
本文唯一史源为司马迁《史记·淮阴侯列传》。其中人物对话是史家记述，未必逐字；「誠令成安君聽足下計，若信者亦已爲禽矣」出自韩信之口，属事后自述，不可检验。除原文所记理由外，本文未对陈馀的心理作任何补充；作者提出的替代情形只用于分析，不作事实陈述。

The only historical source for this piece is Sima Qian's "Account of the Marquis of Huaiyin" in the Records of the Grand Historian. The speeches there are the historian's account and need not be verbatim; the statement that, had the Lord of Cheng'an heeded Li Zuoche's plan, a man like Han Xin would already have been taken comes from Han Xin's own mouth, an after-the-fact statement that cannot be tested. Beyond the reasons recorded in the original text, this piece adds nothing to Chen Yu's psychology; the alternative scenario the author offers serves analysis only and is not stated as fact.

dispositions.rationale: J-E9记李左车最先以败军之将推辞，J-E10与J-E9是否前后相接，证据并未显示。因此中文把“李左车开口说的是”改为“原文又记李左车说”，“开口先讲的”改为“在这里讲的”；英文“began with”改为“The text also records Li Zuoche saying”，“opened by suggesting”改为“here suggests”。未采用建议中的“随后”“now”，因为这两种说法同样暗示时间先后。

dispositions.rationale: 原文「亦已」只是“已经”的意思，所以删去“long ago”，改为“would already have been taken”，与 story.6 一致。另依规则4，英文不应给译述加引号冒充原文，因此改成不带引号的转述。中文本来就准确，按原文照录。
